name: character-matters-workspace
description: Character Matters Video & eBook Platform Monorepo Workspace

scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix welcome run dev"

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix welcome install
